title: Lean proofs
summary: 21 kernel-checked theorems; standard axioms only. Full graph semantics and faster algorithm theorem remain open.

claims.label: Faster exact algorithm
claims.detail: No improved algorithm or bound has been proved.

claims.label: Isolate either cherry endpoint
claims.detail: Four-leaf assignment-model optimum is two; every feasible forest isolating endpoint 0 or 1 requires at least three components.

claims.label: Lean checkpoint
claims.detail: Executed Lake build, all 21 theorem axiom audits, and deliberately false forest rejection retained in the certificate.

lemmas.label: Rooted isomorphism
lemmas.detail: Boolean checker is equivalent to an independent inductive label-preserving rooted-isomorphism relation.

lemmas.label: Complete assignments
lemmas.detail: Enumeration contains every bounded length-n assignment and no other assignment.

lemmas.label: Exact minimum selector
lemmas.detail: Returns a feasible minimum-cost list member; none exactly when no feasible list member exists.

lemmas.label: Assignment optimum
lemmas.detail: Returned forest minimizes components over every bounded assignment in the executable embedding model.

lemmas.label: Endpoint counterexample
lemmas.detail: 256-assignment kernel check plus universal bounded-assignment consequences: optimum two, endpoint isolation at least three.

lemmas.label: Graph correspondence
lemmas.detail: Prove minimal embedding graph semantics and that all set partitions admit bounded assignments; then prove guaranteed success on every well-formed instance.

lemmas.label: Faster algorithm proof
lemmas.detail: New reduction/branch completeness, full cost model, worst-case recurrence, original-k bound, and fresh verification are still required.
